name: Rapunzel's Tangled Adventure
description: Set between “Tangled” and “Tangled Ever After,” this animated adventure/comedy series unfolds as Rapunzel acquaints herself with her parents, her kingdom and the people of Corona.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Check Mate
videos.overview: Pascal tries to entice Maximus to play chess.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Prison Bake
videos.overview: Attila explains how he creates his baked goods.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Make Me Smile
videos.overview: Rapunzel attempts to make Scowly Crowley smile.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Hare Peace
videos.overview: Rapunzel is tasked to watch the Cobbler's pet bunny.

videos.title: LOL with Rapunzel
videos.overview: LOL with Rapunzel, Flynn, Cassandra and the rest of the kingdom!

videos.title: Short Cuts: Night Bite
videos.overview: When Raps camps out under the stars, Max has difficulty guarding her when he is plagued by a single mosquito.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Hiccup Fever
videos.overview: Everyone is eager to present the perfect cure when Rapunzel comes down with a bad case of the hiccups.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Snowball
videos.overview: Rapunzel and Pascal's plan to make the perfect snowman turns into a treacherous, downhill chase.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Hairdon't
videos.overview: Rapunzel gives Eugene a haircut, but it doesn't turn out as well as she'd hoped.

videos.title: Short Cuts: Unicorny
videos.overview: Rapunzel puts her private eye skills to work when Vladimir's favorite ceramic unicorn goes missing.

videos.title: What the Hair?!
videos.overview: Rapunzel and Cassandra venture out to a wizard’s cottage to try and find out what has happened to her hair.

videos.title: Rapunzel's Enemy
videos.overview: When Rapunzel gets booed, she becomes determined to win over her naysayer, a little old man who is loved by everyone in the kingdom.

videos.title: Fitzherbert P.I.
videos.overview: Eugene sets out to find a role for himself in the castle and decides to be a royal guard, but to pass muster, he must overcome the Captain's preconceptions.

videos.title: Challenge of the Brave
videos.overview: When Cassandra enters the Challenge of the Brave, Rapunzel decides to enter the challenge as well causing both girls’ competitive nature to come out!

videos.title: Cassandra v. Eugene
videos.overview: Rapunzel is sick of the constant bickering between Cassandra and Eugene, so she sends them off on a scavenger hunt as a bonding experience.

videos.title: The Return of Strongbow
videos.overview: When Eugene‘s old friend Lance Strongbow sweeps back into town, he tries to drag Eugene back into his thieving ways.

videos.title: In Like Flynn
videos.overview: In order to prank a rival monarch, King Frederic recruits Eugene to help pull off a scheme.

videos.title: Great Expotations
videos.overview: Cassandra is given the chance to be a guard for the Judge of the Exposition of the Sciences, but only if she can complete her handmaiden duties in time.

videos.title: Under Raps
videos.overview: Rapunzel discovers that Cassandra has a new crush, but could Cassandra's new beau be interested in more than Cassandra's heart?

videos.title: One Angry Princess
videos.overview: When Attila is accused of destroying Monty's Sweet Shoppe, Rapunzel's the only one who believes the Pub Thug's cries of innocence.

videos.title: Pascal's Story
videos.overview: When Pascal begins to feel that he doesn't fit into Rapunzel's new life in the castle, he runs away and returns to the tower.

videos.title: Big Brothers of Corona
videos.overview: When an infamous thief turns out to be two orphaned little girls, Eugene and Lance try to turn the girls away from their life of crime.

videos.title: The Wrath of Ruthless Ruth
videos.overview: When The Snuggly Duckling suddenly becomes haunted by its original owner, Ruthless Ruth, Rapunzel helps the Pub Thugs figure out the reason behind the ghost’s return.

videos.title: Max's Enemy
videos.overview: When a new crime-fighting horse arrives in Corona, it doesn’t take long for Maximus to realize his new stablemate didn’t come to town to make nice.

videos.title: The Way of the Willow
videos.overview: When Rapunzel discovers that Queen Arianna has an estranged sister, she invites her newly discovered Aunt Willow to Corona.

videos.title: Queen for a Day
videos.overview: When the King and Queen leave town, Rapunzel is set to lead. However, when a blizzard threatens to destroy Corona, the Princess is faced with some tough decisions.

videos.title: Painter's Block
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the blizzard, Rapunzel's confidence is shaken. In an effort to get her "mojo" back, she rededicates herself to painting, and enrolls in an art class.

videos.title: Not in the Mood
videos.overview: Fed up with the constant bickering, Max and Pascal give Rapunzel, Cass and Eugene an attitude reversing potion.

videos.title: The Quest for Varian
videos.overview: When Rapunzel investigates a cryptic message from Varian, she finds herself on the run from a group of masked men.

videos.title: The Alchemist Returns
videos.overview: Rapunzel agrees to help Varian recover the sundrop flower, but the princess learns the young alchemist has shadier intentions than he had first suggested.

videos.title: Secret of the Sun Drop
videos.overview: Rapunzel must face her greatest threat yet, when Varian, desperate to save his father, takes the Queen prisoner.

videos.title: Beyond the Corona Walls
videos.overview: Finally outside the kingdom's walls, Rapunzel begins her long journey following the path of the black rocks.

videos.title: The Return of Quaid
videos.overview: When a new crime boss tries to rise to power in Vardaros, Rapunzel attempts to persuade an old lawman out of retirement to help save the day.

videos.title: Goodbye and Goodwill
videos.overview: Rapunzel plans to bring the Goodwill Festival to Vardaros, but when the locals respond more favorably to Cassandra’s ideas, Rapunzel becomes competitive.

videos.title: Forest of No Return
videos.overview: When the gang gets lost in the mysterious Forest of No Return, they must rely on the mysterious Adira as their guide.

videos.title: Freebird
videos.overview: Rapunzel’s adventurous spirit leads the gang to a hidden corner of the woods where everyone is magically transformed into birds.

videos.title: Vigor the Visionary
videos.overview: When Rapunzel and Eugene visit a psychic monkey, his visions lead them on an adventure to find the family of their old friend and young thief, Angry.

videos.title: Keeper of the Spire
videos.overview: To acquire a piece of the scroll, Rapunzel travels to an ancient museum at the top of an impossibly tall spire with the museum’s incredibly arrogant curator.

videos.title: King Pascal
videos.overview: Tiny islanders the Lorbs mistake Pascal for their mystical ruler; the chameleon loves the adulation, until he's expected to protect his people from a vicious monster.

videos.title: There's Something About Hook Foot
videos.overview: Hook Foot falls in love with a mermaid with ulterior motives.

videos.title: Happiness Is...
videos.overview: A homesick Rapunzel discovers a mysterious idol with the power to bring instant happiness to whomever holds it, but its power threatens to tear the group apart.

videos.title: Max and Eugene in 'Peril on the High Seas'
videos.overview: When Max and Eugene are stranded at sea they are saved by a passing ship only to discover that it is not what they expected.

videos.title: Curses!
videos.overview: Rapunzel again encounters Madame Zabrina and Vigor the Visionary. Vigor puts a curse on Rapunzel just before she and her friends cross a perilous mountain pass.

videos.title: The Eye of Pincosta
videos.overview: To bail Eugene out of jail, Rapunzel must team up with Stalyan, Eugene's ex-fiancée, to find a diamond the two thieves had stolen years ago.

videos.title: Rapunzel and the Great Tree
videos.overview: Rapunzel and her companions finally reach the mysterious Great Tree, but their journey forward is hindered by a dangerous new adversary who will stop at nothing to turn them back.

videos.title: The Brothers Hook
videos.overview: Hook Foot is forced to confront his past and re-evaluate his life choices when the group attends a concert and he unexpectedly reunites with his brother, Hook Hand.

videos.title: Rapunzel: Day One
videos.overview: When a magical accident erases Rapunzel's memories of everything that has happened since leaving her tower, Cassandra must scramble to find a cure before the amnesia becomes permanent.

videos.title: Mirror, Mirror
videos.overview: Seeking shelter from a fierce storm, the group takes refuge in a hospitable but mysterious old mansion where strange hallway mirrors hold a dark and dangerous secret.

videos.title: You're Kidding Me!
videos.overview: Rapunzel and Eugene are forced to act as temporary parents when a magical artifact accidentally transforms Cassandra, Lance, and Shorty into mischievous young children.

videos.title: Rapunzeltopia
videos.overview: Rapunzel finds herself back in Corona as if all the events of the black rocks and Varian never happened.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Rapunzel and Eugene must traverse a deadly maze, and their guide through the labyrinth is Vigor the Visionary.

videos.title: Destinies Collide
videos.overview: Rapunzel follows the black rocks to the Dark Kingdom to uncover the truth behind her destiny.

videos.title: Rapunzel's Return
videos.overview: After learning the reason behind Cassandra’s betrayal, Rapunzel returns to Corona only to find it taken over by one of her most dangerous enemies.

videos.title: Return of the King
videos.overview: King Edmund arrives in Corona to give his son, Eugene, a family heirloom. When the heirloom is stolen, Eugene reluctantly joins his dad on a journey to retrieve it.

videos.title: Who's Afraid of the Big, Bad Wolf?
videos.overview: Rapunzel and Eugene's friends Angry and Red return to Corona permanently and their return quickly becomes a nightmare when the kingdom is stalked by a werewolf.

videos.title: The Lost Treasure of Herz Der Sonne
videos.overview: After discovering a map to a mythical treasure, Rapunzel believes that holding a race to claim it will be just the pick-me-up the people of Corona need.

videos.title: No Time Like the Past
videos.overview: An ancient hourglass sends Rapunzel and Pascal back in time, and their only hope of returning to the present is in the hands of a teenage Lance and Eugene.

videos.title: Beginnings
videos.overview: As Rapunzel struggles with Cassandra’s betrayal, the princess recounts the story of how she and Cassandra first became friends.

videos.title: The King and Queen of Hearts
videos.overview: Rapunzel finds that her parents' memory loss has made them forget how they fell in love; things get complicated when King Trevor tries to steal the Queen's heart.

videos.title: Day of the Animals
videos.overview: Max, Pascal and the animals must rescue Rapunzel and the gang from being trapped forever in a magical prison.

videos.title: Be Very Afraid
videos.overview: When Corona is overcome by a new strain of rocks that induces fearful visions, Rapunzel teams up with Varian to put an end to the new threat

videos.title: Pascal's Dragon
videos.overview: Pascal befriends a baby dragon but as the dragon grows, Pascal has to choose between his new friend and the safety of Corona.

videos.title: Islands Apart
videos.overview: After receiving a message from Owl, Rapunzel and Eugene travel back to the island of the Lorbs, where they reconnect with the Captain of the Guard.

videos.title: Cassandra's Revenge
videos.overview: When Rapunzel feels ready to settle down and begin living a normal life, Cassandra returns to Corona with a score to settle.

videos.title: Race to the Spire
videos.overview: Rapunzel, Eugene, and their old friend Calliope must race against time to reach the Spire and prevent Cassandra from acquiring a devastating new weapon.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
videos.overview: Rapunzel and Cassandra are unexpectedly forced to cross paths when both set out to investigate rumors of Mother Gothel's ghost haunting their old childhood home.

videos.title: Flynnpostor
videos.overview: When a mysterious new thief goes on a brazen crime spree using the alias Flynn Rider, Eugene sets out to track down the impostor and clear his former name.

videos.title: Once a Handmaiden...
videos.overview: As Corona prepares for an impending attack by developing a powerful new defense system, Cassandra secretly infiltrates the kingdom disguised as a humble handmaiden.

videos.title: Plus Est En Vous
videos.overview: Rapunzel and her friends must take Corona back from Cassandra and confront the evil Zhan Tiri.
